purpose: Prevent silent one-to-one matching across elections whose local constituency boundaries/counts differ.
rules: National vote aggregation is geometry-independent and may use any valid native historical file immediately.
A territorial transition may be fitted only when both elections are expressed on a scientifically admissible common geography.
Never drop, duplicate or fuzzy-force 2002/2007 native districts merely to obtain 92 rows.
A pre-2011 bridge must archive its source basis and state whether it is exact or approximate.
Approximate split weights based on population/registered voters remain research-only unless pre-registered and sensitivity-tested; target election outcomes may never be used to choose those weights.

accepted_bridge_modes.EXACT_HARMONIZED_ROWS: Bridge artifact contains or points to 92 harmonized rows built from lower-level source components without using future election outcomes.
accepted_bridge_modes.PRE_ELECTION_WEIGHTED_CROSSWALK: Source districts are apportioned by weights fixed from non-outcome pre-election geography/demography; usable only when forecast_eligible=true and sensitivity audit passes.
